name: askdo
description: Askdo turns a user ask into a reusable business kit and executable multi-agent flow.

interface.shortDescription: Turn business asks into reusable kits and executable flows.
interface.longDescription: Askdo helps a host agent understand a business need, build or reuse a user-owned kit, run the kit flow, and return a practical result.
defaultPrompt: Use Askdo to build a competitor analysis kit.
Use Askdo to run my market research ask.
Use Askdo to turn this process into a reusable kit.
